decisions.reason: The firm has invested in the product's development and rebranding over several years, and the only reported result is vaguely positive rather than clearly disappointing, so escalation of commitment favors keeping it.

The firm publicly presented the flail shredder line at RecyclingAktiv and updated its engine technology, creating visible commitments that escalation of commitment makes hard to abandon despite limited performance information.
Although specific results are limited, the firm has invested in a multi-model grinder line and distinguishes it from the dropped green-waste variant, so escalation of commitment favors persistence.
Strong public claims of setting standards and a quantified installation indicate high prior investment and visible commitment, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it.
